assessment: Physical skill acceptance halted. Operator reported unwanted turns/jitter and an actual Sit/paw tip; stationary sensor observations are inconsistent with a motionless supported robot. Sensor-only followups improve but do not identify a repeatable remedy or validate hardware motion.
scope: Read-only preservation and offline analysis. No motor, ROS, calibration, training, deployment or production-source changes by this analysis task. Root separately ran the recorded sensor-only probes.

operator_observations.provenance: User observations relayed by root during the supervised session; sensor yaw alone is not independent confirmation.
operator_observations.finite_skills: Operator reported about90deg counterclockwise turn and jitter on repeated downward-dog and stand-sit-stand.
operator_observations.sit_comparison: Operator reported actual tip and self-stop during left-paw request; no lifting/button. Earlier isolated successful observations do not establish repeatability.
operator_observations.stationary_check: Root asked operator to support robot motionless on stand for20s.

commands_and_heading.joystick_observation: No button events during clip windows; stickaxes stable with small left-X offset. This does not prove absence of every possible prior/internal command.
commands_and_heading.inferred_phase_limits: Activation/API logs define nominal controller/initialization/fade windows. IMU orientation may be wrong, so heading deltas are sensor estimates.
commands_and_heading.largest_net_heading_changes: Repeated return intervals DD−23.95deg, pee−45.76deg, stand-sit-stand−51.82deg; transient changes also occur during clips.
commands_and_heading.tracking: No single consistent failing joint. Return aggregate target-minus-positionRMS about.094/.099/.110rad. Target publication begins after initialization, so init tracking is only sparse late samples.

tip_timing.interpretation: Native cutoff reacts to its sensed tilt threshold. API poll timing is not physical stop latency. Physical tip is independently operator-reported; attitude magnitude is not trustworthy after failed stationary test.

stationary_native.interpretation: Smooth sustained sensor-frame-X bias maps to bodyX/Z through documented mount transform. No gross axis/order swap or quaternion-wrap jump explains this pattern. Duplicated100Hz sensor states in faster publishing are not alone proof of stale failure.

probe1.accuracy: All valid gyro3, all rotation0. Bias persists/fluctuates across5s bins.

probe2.accuracy: Rotation0; Game3; gyro3. Calibration readback flags1,0,1,0,1; no calibrationtoggle in probe.
probe2.startup: Game initial tilt11.69deg settles near2.7deg; use settled windows.
probe2.interpretation: Both streams have much smaller drift on second probe. Reset/time/temperature/config timing differ; no causal attribution to Game, reset or calibration and no accepted motion remedy.

confirmed_source_and_transport_limits.timestamp: Existing driver uses unsigned rawBaseTimestamp as microseconds and omits per-reportdelay; vendor uses signed100us ticks plus reportdelay referenced to HINT. Current logged ages are not verified physical sensor ages.
confirmed_source_and_transport_limits.parser: Payloadread failures can retain cacheddata; repeatedallzeroheaderreads observed despite successful syscalllengths; additionalreports and oversizedpayload handling incomplete. These defects are concrete but their causal contribution to smooth bias is not established.
confirmed_source_and_transport_limits.acceleration: Accelerometer reports disabled and Output.acc notassigned; recordedzeros are not valid acceleration/vibration measurements.

historical_interpretation_correction.correction: Treat IMU-delay schedules as controlled perturbations derived from logged driver-age values, not accurate sensor-age replay. Exact historical artifacts remain unchanged. No slew candidate promoted; no new training justified from these faulty sensor observations.

continuation_recovery.tail: Partial final MessageIndex record; no complete message discarded at this boundary. Original recorder buffers beforepowerloss unknown.
continuation_recovery.guarantees: Rawunchanged; completedrecords structurallyvalidated; rewrittenmessage payload/topic/time/sequence digestmatches readback. SourceCRCdisabled, cannot retrospectively prove sourcechunkintegrity.

shutdown.reason: Actual tip and failed stationary IMU check; operator has placed robot supported on stand. Disable motors, no rehoming.

rejected_inferences: IMU yaw doesnot establish actualturn angle afterstationaryfailure.
Neither sourcebugs nor temperature nor carpet is established as solecause.
Lowdrift secondprobe doesnot validate dynamicorientation or normalnativecontrol.
A softwarecompleteclip or earlier isolated successfulmotion doesnot establish repeatablephysicalskill.
No policy/gain/limit change is justified by these data alone.
next_measurement_requirements: Validate pure transport/parser correction against exact captured fixtures before any deployment.
Establish repeatable stationary attitude/gyro behavior with reportstatus and explicitstartup settling, then compare coherent native output.
Require external supervised orientation/motion observations before reaccepting any locomotion/Sit/finite/generated skill.
